name: Faiza Alvarez
summary: Faiza (Instagram handle @faiza_alvarez) is a client who came in after a man began harassing her — mass-reporting her posts, filing a false copyright claim that got a photo taken down, and emailing/extorting her — leaving her account shadow-banned. She sent screenshots of the harassment and the fake reporter/email, handed over her IG login so the team's account specialist could work the account, and negotiated the job down to $400 payable after completion (she couldn't afford the larger quoted package). As of 2026-08-11 the copyright appeal has been submitted and the post recovery is still in progress; she's anxious, checks in frequently for updates, and needs proactive status messages.
key_facts: Agreed $400, paid after the work is completed (declined the higher-priced full package)
Shared IG login credentials twice (password was reset by Instagram after a new login was detected)
Harasser filed a false copyright strike that removed one photo; also mass-reported pics and deleted comments/story replies
Account was shadow-banned; she previously got locked out for 24h after a re-login attempt and is nervous about repeating it
Very trust-sensitive — was reassured that the specialist works full-time for ALTR and has done thousands of accounts
Asked to hop on a call before starting; a phone call was arranged around 5pm on 2026-08-06
Open item as of 2026-08-11: copyright appeal submitted, waiting on the post being restored
